title: I was going to call you
goal: Talk about plans that fell through with -(y)AcAktI, and about what is about to happen with -mAk üzere.

intro.text: `-(y)AcAk` + *-tI* is **was going to**, usually for a plan that didn't happen: *Seni arayacaktım ama unuttum* (I was going to call you, but I forgot). *-mAk üzere* is **about to**: *Tren kalkmak üzere* (The train is about to leave).

vocab.en: to change your mind; to give up (on something: -DAn)

exercises.question: How do you say **I was going to call you**?

why.2: *Arıyordum* is **I was calling you**, or **I was looking for you**.

exercises.explain: A plan seen from the past: *ara-y-acak* + *-tı* + *-m*. The k doesn't soften, because a consonant follows.

exercises.label: *yapmak* (to do): I was going to do, you were going to do…
exercises.explain: *yap-acak* + *-tı* (after k, t) + the past endings. The k stays k: no vowel follows it.

exercises.en: I was going to call you, but I forgot.

reject.why: *Arayacağım* is the future, **I'll call you**. With *ama unuttum*, the plan is in the past: *arayacaktım*.

exercises.prompt: Bu yaz İzmir'e gidecektik ama son anda vazgeçtik.
accept: We were going to go to Izmir this summer, but we changed our minds at the last minute.
We were [going to go|going] to Izmir this summer, but we [changed our mind|gave up|gave it up|decided not to] at the last minute.
We were going to Izmir this summer, but we changed our minds at the last minute.
We were [going to go|going] to Izmir this summer, but at the last minute we [changed our minds|changed our mind|gave up|decided not to].
This summer we were [going to go|going] to Izmir, but [we changed our minds|we changed our mind|we gave up|we decided not to] at the last minute.
This summer we were [going to go|going] to Izmir, but at the last minute we [changed our minds|changed our mind|gave up|decided not to].

exercises.en: The train is about to leave.

reject.why: *Üzereyim* is the present, **I'm about to leave**. **Was** needs the past: *üzereydim*.

exercises.en: The film is about to end.
exercises.explain: *-mAk üzere*: **about to**. *Bitmek zorunda* would be **has to end**.
Negative *-me*, buffer y, *-ecek*, then *-ti* and *-m*. Before t, the k stays k.

exercises.question: *Size bir şey soracaktım.* What does the speaker mean?
options: I wanted to ask you something.
exercises.explain: `-(y)AcAktI` is a polite way to bring up a question: **I was going to ask you something**.

exercises.en: The bus came at the last minute.
exercises.explain: *Son anda*: **at the last moment, at the last minute**.

exercises.en: I was going to call you.
